BUKU PI  Open Learning Edition · 2026  
       Buku Pi: Pi Coding Agent Guide 
       Start from installation and your first verifiable task, then gradually come to understand Session, Context, Skill, Extension, and long-running workflows. 
       A terminal Coding Harness learning path reorganized for beginners. Finish one small real task all the way through first, then build your own Pi layer by layer. 
       
         Start from Zero 
         Read the Whole Book Systematically 
       
     
     
               
       CURRENT EDITION 
       
          Core curriculum  14 lessons  
          Learning modules  5 modules  
          Learning archive  98 posts  
          Current edition  2026 Open Edition  
       
       The website and original content use the MIT License 
     
   
   
     The book's method 
     Scenario → Concept → Practice → Verification 
     Every lesson must leave behind a result you can check yourself. 
   
   
     
       
         READING MAP 
         One main path, six functional entry points 
       
       Learn along the main path first, then practice through case studies; when you hit a problem, check the reference guide; when you need an extension, look at the plugins; when you want to trace a complete viewpoint, read the licensed translations. 
     
     
       
         01 · CORE CURRICULUM 
         Buku Pi Main Path 
         The core of the whole site. Enter through the Introduction, pass through 5 modules and 14 lessons, and finish with extensions, VPS, and safety verification. 
         Start with the Introduction → 
       
       
         02 · LAB 
         Case Studies 
         Aligned with the lesson chapters, providing materials, steps, expected results, and a verification checklist. 
         Enter the case library → 
       
       
         03 · REFERENCE 
         Reference Guide 
         An FAQ for quick answers, a troubleshooting guide for tracing by symptom, and a glossary for concepts you do not yet know. 
         Search by problem → 
       
       
         04 · PLUGINS 
         Plugin Picks 
         Built from the practice of 98 tweets, chosen by need, provenance, and risk, not an all-in-one one-click bundle. 
         See the selection map → 
       
       
         05 · RELEASE ARCHIVE 
         Release Notes 
         Browse the release date, feature changes, breaking changes, and bug fixes for every official version. 
         Browse the release notes → 
       
       
         06 · AUTHORIZED TRANSLATIONS 
         Licensed Translations 
         Fourteen complete English translations published under license from Earendil, preserving the original information, license statements, and image attribution. 
         Enter the translation section → 
       
     
     
       AUTHOR'S NOTES 
        Learning notes  holds 98 tweets, personal reflections, and changes of assessment. This is the raw-material archive behind the Buku Pi, not a replacement for the verified tutorials. 
       Read the notes → 
     
   
   
     
       
         THE CURRICULUM 
         Five modules, from installation to a stable workflow 
       
       The main path is ordered by learning prerequisites. Readers who can already run Pi can jump straight into real tasks from the second module.
